<xf:if is="$xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_enable && $xf.visitor.Option.wutime_snowstorm_enable">
	<xf:if is="!$xf.visitor.isMemberOf($xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_ignore_usergroups)">
		<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowScope" value="{{ $xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_display_scope ?: 'everywhere' }}" />
		<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ 0 }}" />
		<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowIncludeForums" value="{{ is_array($xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_scope_forums_include) ? $xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_scope_forums_include : [] }}" />
		<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowExcludeForums" value="{{ is_array($xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_scope_forums_exclude) ? $xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_scope_forums_exclude : [] }}" />

		<xf:if is="$thread && $thread.node_id">
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ $thread.node_id }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$forum && $forum.node_id" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ $forum.node_id }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$xf.reply.thread && $xf.reply.thread.node_id" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ $xf.reply.thread.node_id }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$xf.reply.forum && $xf.reply.forum.node_id" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ $xf.reply.forum.node_id }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$xf.reply.node && $xf.reply.node.node_type_id == 'Forum' && $xf.reply.node.node_id" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowForumId" value="{{ $xf.reply.node.node_id }}" />
		</xf:if>

		<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowScopeAllowed" value="{{ true }}" />

		<xf:if is="$wutimeSnowScope == 'homepage'">
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowScopeAllowed" value="{{ ((($controller == 'XF:Forum' || $controller == 'XF\Pub\Controller\ForumController') && !$forum.node_id) || $xf.reply.template == 'forum_list') }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$wutimeSnowScope == 'selected_forums_only'" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowScopeAllowed" value="{{ $wutimeSnowForumId && in_array($wutimeSnowForumId, $wutimeSnowIncludeForums) }}" />
		<xf:elseif is="$wutimeSnowScope == 'selected_forums_exclude'" />
			<xf:set var="$wutimeSnowScopeAllowed" value="{{ !$wutimeSnowForumId || !in_array($wutimeSnowForumId, $wutimeSnowExcludeForums) }}" />
		</xf:if>

		<xf:if is="$wutimeSnowScopeAllowed">
			<xf:if is="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count == ''">
				<xf:set var="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count" value="1" />
			<xf:elseif is="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count == 0" />
				<xf:comment>WE JUST SHOWED</xf:comment>
				<xf:set var="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count" value="1" />
			<xf:else />
				<xf:comment>WE ENUMERATE</xf:comment>
				<xf:set var="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count" value="{{$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count+1}}" />
			</xf:if>
			<xf:if is="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count >= $xf.options.wutime_snowstorm_show_every_x_views ">

				<xf:comment>
					Reset our page view tracker
				</xf:comment>

				<xf:include template="wutime_snowstorm_snowstorm_javascript"/>

				<xf:set var="$xf.session.wutime_snowstorm_count" value="0" />

			</xf:if>
		</xf:if>
	</xf:if>
</xf:if>

$0
